overview: A store hiring and training roster for TLC that tracks roadies from sign-up through paperwork, orientation and final trainer sign-off.
features: Track roadies from sign-up through paperwork, orientation and training
Trainers and managers sign a roadie off as Certified or Needs more time with a reason
Mark a signed-off roadie as a possible future trainer
See who signed off and when on the roadie card
Sign off roadies straight from Today's My group tiles
Dashboard Certified count follows the sign-off
Demo mode with fake data for practice runs
